product_name_specific: Avensis,  Avensis Verso, Corolla, Yaris, Lexus SC430
risk_description:
The gas generator of the passenger airbag may be defective.
This may result in uncontrolled inflation and release of metal fragments when the airbag is activated, causing injuries to the occupants.
